semantics.identity_rule: Each plan/candidate has an explicit identity.
semantics.step_rule: Every step references exact tool/operation identity.
semantics.validation_rule: All steps/bindings/capabilities validate before or at execution according to policy.
semantics.authority_rule: Plan approval does not create blanket authority; each effect remains gated.

invariants.rule: Command, Routine, Trigger, Schedule, Tool and model definitions remain separate from invocations, requests, executions and results; definitions never create effects merely by existing.
Automated work still resolves exact operation/target/context and must cross validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before any effect occurs.

hard_gates.condition: tool order inferred from list text
result fields mapped by name heuristics
plan approval grants all future rights

references.purpose: Plan steps create exact tool invocation requests.
